decisions.decision: Tier 4's database design APPROVED as specified: one migration doing the 4-table move, the supercharger_history rename, the 9 catalog renames and the COMMENT refresh
decisions.why: Rejected: move-only (repeats the 41-statement sweep later, leaves two supercharger_sessions alive) and split-in-two (same work, adds an intermediate state).

decisions.why: Verified each myself: 8 type refs (7 test + 1 comment), 15 name blocks, EXPLAIN hits real, 20260903000001 free. None blocks implementation.

decisions.decision: Did NOT ask the owner to run the suite at the end of wave 1
